encode_bytes_element: encode a scalar value to the KServe Triton BYTES wire format
encode_bytes_tensor: encode a numpy BYTES tensor as a length-prefixed byte stream
decode_bytes_tensor: decode a length-prefixed BYTES payload to a numpy object array
review_encode_bytes_tensor: review the encode_bytes_tensor function for length-prefixed byte stream encoding
review_decode_bytes_tensor: review the decode_bytes_tensor function for length-prefixed byte stream decoding
